name: Stylam Industries Ltd
title: Stylam Industries Ltd - 526951 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Third greenfield laminate plant delayed again to end-June/July; management guides FY27 revenue up 20-25% and new plant ~INR250-300 crore, with capex of INR334 crore already spent and no prior numeric baseline to test against.

utilisation.quote: the laminate division achieved a 74% capacity utilization in FY26

capex.quote: We have at this moment done the capex of INR334 crores.

triggers.label: New plant delayed again to June/July
triggers.quote: the commencement of the commercial production will be end June, maximum early July

triggers.label: Price hikes 3-5% to customers
triggers.quote: We already increased 3% to 5% to our customers, almost every manufacturer.

triggers.label: FY27 revenue growth 20-25%
triggers.quote: it will be definitely 20%, 25% increase than the p revious

triggers.label: April best month; 3-figure crore sales
triggers.quote: our last month sale, we already have 3 figures sales, which is the first time in our history

guidance.quote: Hopefully it will be maximum middle of July, minimum end of June
For this financial year, I think we will target INR250 crores to INR300 crores from that particular plant
it will be definitely 20%, 25% increase than the p revious
we would be doing approximately between INR50 crores to INR70 crores

guidance.metric: Gross margin/EBITDA margin for new plant
guidance.quote: It would be on the same pattern.

red_flags.label: Repeated commissioning delays
red_flags.quote: our new capacity was supposed to come live by November, then we shifted the guidance to March

red_flags.label: Vague and inconsistent numeric guidance
red_flags.quote: I think we cannot give you the exact number what we will be closing in 31st March '27

red_flags.label: Management structure and open-offer/SHA ambiguity
red_flags.quote: Even if they have a put option as per the SHA, that doesn't mean that they will be acquiring more shares

evasions.topic: New plant revenue and utilisation ramp
evasions.quote: It will not be good to answer exact figures.
we will be sitting down and see how we can help each other
